review_candidates.title: Project Manager - Time & Attendance (T&A) North America
review_candidates.description: Division: Weir Minerals Location: Mexico (remote) What We Do At Weir We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining. Make your impact As the T&A Project Manager for North America (NAM), you will lead the implementation and successful delivery of Time & Attendance solutions across the region, ensuring project plans are effectively executed and key milestones are achieved. This is a hands-on delivery leadership role, combining project governance with active involvement in project execution. Acting as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders, implementation partners, and program leadership, you will manage delivery activities, vendor performance, stakeholder engagement, and business readiness initiatives to ensure successful, compliant, and sustainable T&A deployments. What You’ll Do Project Planning & Governance: Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, governance frameworks, and documentation, ensuring alignment with global program objectives, regional business needs, and implementation partner methodologies. Project Delivery & Vendor Management: Lead end-to-end T&A implementations across North America, coordinating cross-functional teams, implementation partners, and technology vendors to deliver all project phases, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, go-live, and transition to ongoing support. Risk, RAIDD & Readiness Management: Manage RAIDD governance, proactively identifying risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies, while overseeing mitigation plans, stage-gate readiness assessments, operational preparedness, and go-live approvals across multiple countries and business units. Change Management & Adoption: Partner with change, communications, and training teams to drive business readiness, user adoption, process standardization, and successful implementation of future-state workforce management processes, balancing global standards with regional operational and compliance requirements. Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement: Provide project reporting and executive communications, including status updates, milestone tracking, project health indicators, resource and budget impacts, governance materials, and escalation of critical issues, while building strong relationships with business and leadership stakeholders. Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture. What You’ll Bring Must-haves: 2 - 5 years leading Time & Attendance (T&A), Workforce Management (WFM), or Timekeeping system implementations Experience delivering end-to-end projects across multiple countries, including vendor and implementation partner management. Proficiency with workforce management platforms such as ADP eTime, ADP Essential, ADP EZ Labour, UKG, WorkForce Software, Dayforce, SAP SuccessFactors Time, Workday Time Tracking, or similar solutions. Strong understanding of T&A processes, Payroll/HRIS integrations, RAIDD governance, project reporting, and executive stakeholder communication. Fluent in English. Nice-to-haves: Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2 Practitioner, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or equivalent project management certification Agile, Scrum, or other project delivery certifications Experience supporting workforce management programs in North America, including knowledge of labor regulations, workforce scheduling, and timekeeping compliance across multiple countries. Experience working in global transformation initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations. Why join Weir? We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes. We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies. We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives. Benefits Competitive pay Access to global inclusion networks Regional and team-specific benefits Sharebuilder scheme Wellness support for you and your family Collaboration with global teams

review_candidates.title: Product Quality Engineer
review_candidates.description: Description ABOUT METRC Metrc is the most trusted and experienced provider of cannabis regulatory systems in the United States and is growing extremely rapidly to expand globally. We provide a solution that combines advanced software, radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology, a dedicated customer-support team, and a secure database to track and trace cannabis from growth, harvest, and processing to testing, transport, and sale. As a Quality Engineer, you will have the opportunity to thrive in a fast-moving, fluid environment, and be passionate about implementing change, great processes and procedures in a commercial setting at a fast-growing technology company. General Overview Metrc is seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to own software quality and technical workflow validation across our platform and integrated product ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that Metrc’s software — including its core track-and-trace platform, APIs, and third-party integrations — performs reliably, accurately, and in accordance with both functional requirements and regulatory obligations. This is a technically substantive role that goes beyond functional UI testing. You will work across system boundaries, validate complex data flows, and troubleshoot issues that span software configurations, API behavior, integration handoffs, and end-to-end business workflows. The right candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable with technical complexity, and experienced working in SaaS environments where quality failures carry real-world consequences. Key Responsibilities Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Software Testing & Validation Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for new features, platform updates, and integration changes across Metrc’s software product suite. Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end workflow testing, ensuring coverage across user-facing features and underlying technical behaviors. Validate API behavior — including request/response accuracy, error handling, edge cases, and data integrity — using tools such as Postman or comparable platforms. Test complex multi-step workflows that span Metrc’s platform and third-party integrations, including POS systems, ERP platforms, and state regulatory reporting interfaces. Contribute to test automation strategies and, where applicable, develop or maintain automated test scripts to improve coverage and efficiency over time. Troubleshooting & Defect Management Investigate and reproduce software defects reported through internal QA, customer escalations, or cross-functional team channels, providing clear and thorough documentation of findings. Conduct root cause analysis on software failures, distinguishing between application bugs, configuration issues, data problems, and integration faults. Manage the full defect lifecycle in Jira, including logging, prioritization, retesting, and closure, ensuring defect records are accurate and actionable for engineering teams. Collaborate with Engineering to validate bug fixes and confirm that resolutions meet acceptance criteria before release. Identify patterns across reported issues that may indicate systemic problems, and surface those findings proactively to QA and Product leadership. Workflow & Integration QA Validate technical workflows end-to-end across integrated systems, ensuring that data flows correctly between Metrc’s platform and connected third-party applications. Test configuration-driven behaviors — such as state-specific compliance rules, licensee settings, and feature flags — to confirm that software behaves as intended across varied customer environments. Evaluate the impact of platform changes on downstream integrations and flag risks to release readiness when workflow-level impacts are identified. Collaborate with the Configuration Specialist to validate customer-specific platform setups, helping to identify and resolve QA issues that surface during onboarding or go-live activities. Release Readiness & Cross-Functional Collaboration Participate in release readiness reviews, providing a documented QA readiness assessment based on acceptance criteria and test completion standards as input into cross-functional release decisions. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and the Release Manager to communicate test status, outstanding defects, and risk assessments ahead of release milestones. Contribute to the definition of acceptance criteria for new features and user stories, ensuring testability is considered during the planning and design process. Support the development of QA standards and release readiness criteria in partnership with the Head of Quality. Documentation & Continuous Improvement Maintain thorough, well-organized QA documentation in Confluence and Jira, including test plans, test cases, execution results, and defect records. Contribute to the development and refinement of QA processes, testing frameworks, and standards as the quality function matures. Participate in post-release retrospectives and help translate findings into actionable improvements to test coverage or process. Stay current with software QA methodologies, tooling, and best practices, applying relevant advances to improve Metrc’s quality outcomes. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS- KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES Required 4+ years of experience in software QA engineering within a SaaS or software product environment. Demonstrated experience testing APIs and validating complex technical workflows across integrated systems. Proficiency with API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or equivalent, with the ability to construct, execute, and evaluate API test cases independently. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and QA’s role within sprint-based delivery models. Advanced proficiency with Jira for defect management, test tracking, and reporting; experience with Confluence for documentation. Solid analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a structured approach to root cause analysis across multi-system environments. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear defect reports, test documentation, and QA status summaries for technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working in regulated, compliance-driven, or government-adjacent industries where software accuracy and data integrity carry significant consequence. Preferred Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar) and practical involvement in building or maintaining automated test suites. Familiarity with SQL or comparable query tools for validating data integrity and tracing data flows across system boundaries. Background in testing configuration-driven or multi-tenant SaaS platforms where customer-specific rules and settings materially affect software behavior. Experience validating integrations with third-party platforms such as POS systems, ERP solutions, or state regulatory reporting interfaces. Knowledge of cannabis technology, track-and-trace compliance requirements, or state regulatory software environments. ISTQB certification or equivalent formal QA training is a plus.

Key Stakeholders Suppliers Sourcing Buyers / Category Managers (IBM and Client-side) Requesters (Client-side) Accounts Payable Line Management Scope of Work Operates as an individual contributor with full ownership of day-to-day procurement activities. Responsible for meeting operational metrics and ensuring compliance with procurement policies. Makes informed decisions based on gathered data and stakeholder input. Ability to speak Mandarin in business context Strong understanding of procurement operations and ability to translate business needs into procurement actions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong time management and prioritization abilities. High attention to detail and a quality-driven mindset. Self-motivated, assertive, and collaborative team player. Familiarity with procurement systems and tools. Knowledge of category strategies and business control requirements. Ability to maintain high levels of client and stakeholder satisfaction. Malaysia Enterprise Operations Hybrid Professional PETALING JAYA, MY (0088) IBM Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.

review_candidates.title: Print Marketing Director
review_candidates.description: Job Description Print Marketing Director Maternity Cover November 2026 – August 2027 We are looking for an experienced Print Marketing Director to join our in-house creative studio and lead Language Abroad’s annual, multi-market offline marketing programme during a period of maternity cover from November 2026 – end of August 2027. In this role, you will own the direction, prioritisation, budget, resourcing and successful delivery of offline projects for Language Abroad, EF’s language and cultural immersion programs. Managing a team of up to 10, and working with creative teams, global markets, stakeholders and suppliers, you will ensure that work is delivered to the required standard, budget and critical deadlines. Projects include, but are not limited to: brochures, flyers, magazines, supplementary materials, OOH as well as adhoc offline requests for 45 global markets. A key part of the role will be to spearhead a new, AI-enabled process for content production for a more structured and automated workflow. Your Key Responsibilities Will Include Print programme leadership: Lead the annual print cycle from planning and scope-setting through to production, delivery and season close. Set priorities, scope, ambition and quality standards across brochures/magazines and other print materials. Lead the integrated project plan, key milestones and critical production dates. Lead decisions when timing, cost, quality and stakeholder expectations conflict. Market and stakeholder management: Act as the senior point of contact for markets, Country Managers, Product Heads, leadership and other stakeholders. Set clear expectations around deadlines, localisation, approvals and content changes. Lead stakeholder reviews of content and resolve conflicting requirements or escalations. Lead trainings for markets on the requirements to participate in the production process, coordinate orders, stock levels, global launch dates, software/tools training, and ensure local market teams understand production constraints. Budget, suppliers and production oversight: Own the print marketing budget and handle significant production and supplier decisions. Lead the overall printer and supplier strategy in partnership with the Print Production Manager. Manage contracts, quotes, paper orders, volumes, production schedules, deliveries, customs processes and delivery risks. Ensure production starts to time with content, creative, technical and commercial requirements finalised. Protect key timing windows and lead recovery plans when delivery is at risk. People and Team Management: Lead recruitment and onboarding of freelancers/temporary staff. Manage a team of up to 10, allocating capacity across projects and requests. Identify and resolve resource risks across copywriting, design, photography, editorial and production. Own the programme-level risk position, particularly around localisation, amends, printer capacity, paper availability, missing approvals and staffing. AI & Automation oversight: Spearhead the design and implementation of a new print material content-production process using AI, structured content and automation. Work with editorial, creative, production and relevant technical partners to define templates, content fields, data structures, prompts, rules and approval stages. Identify opportunities to automate content drafting, adaptation, versioning, localisation and the flow of approved text into brochure layouts. Establish quality-control, version-control and approval processes to ensure that AI-assisted content is accurate, on-brand and aligned with product information. Train and support copywriters, designers and other team members in the new workflow, including how to build and maintain files correctly for automated content flow. Lead adoption of the process and ensure it improves efficiency without compromising editorial quality, creativity or accountability. Quality Assurance: Own the final quality sign off for print materials across editorial, creative, product and technical standards. Manage final approvals and sign off at key stages throughout the project from stakeholders, and markets all the way to printer softproofs and okay-to-print. Press-pass at printers across productions. What We’re Looking For 8+ years’ experience leading complex print marketing, publishing, editorial or creative production programmes, navigating multi-market environments. Extensive experience managing brochures, catalogues, magazines, annual reports, or similar high-volume print materials from scope through to delivery, in education/travel/retail/publishing. Experience managing budgets, suppliers, production deadlines and competing stakeholder priorities. Experience managing editorial workflows, substantial localization, approvals, version control, print production and supplier relations. Experience leading teams, planning capacity and managing temporary or project-based resource. Experience introducing AI, automation, structured content or data-driven publishing workflows; experience connecting content to layouts or InDesign automation would be highly valuable. Ability to translate a new process into clear standards, training and practical team adoption. Confident negotiating with senior stakeholders, markets and suppliers. Calm, decisive and commercially aware, with strong judgement under pressure. What EF Zurich Offers We are a global, mission driven company, our goal? Open the world through education and cultural exchange. We are an International team, with an international audience, and have opportunities to work across regions. Other benefits include: Discounts on EF programs for Staff, and Staff Friends and Family for all EF Programs Free use of EF Hello: a premium Language Learning App Tuition Reimbursement for continued Education Referral Bonus for all referred staff hires (equivalent for 500 USD) Discounts with our global hotel and travel partners 15% off our on-site Kita Swiss Travel Halb-tax reimbursement And much more! How to apply: Please submit your CV and cover letter in English. Applications in other languages will not be considered. This role is fully in-office. Our onsite policy enhances collaboration, company culture, and faster decision-making. Working together in person fosters creativity, spontaneous idea-sharing, and stronger team connections, which we believe is essential for success. At EF Language Abroad we are dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe. Ready to open the world through education? Apply now!

Leads regular business reviews and touch bases with franchisees to assess performance, marketing ROI, and alignment with brand strategy. Helps ensure adequate marketing investment across franchisees, recommending and influencing marketing budget allocation and media investment split to maximize impact and ROI. Will also run post-campaign analysis to influence future media mix plans. Produces franchisee marketing compliance and performance reporting for the Snr Director Marketing, Americas & Country Director, summarizing calendar adherence, campaign activation, and outstanding gaps. Creative & Brand Standards Approval Acts as the brand’s primary point of contact for Mexico & LATAM franchisees and their creative and social media agencies, reviewing and approving all creative output for compliance with brand standards and guidelines. Guides merchandising direction through competitive benchmarking and best-practice sharing, and briefs/approves new product photography needed for the region in partnership with Culinary Innovation and Brand teams. Conducts regular merchandising compliance via regular restaurant visits. Supports the localization and rollout of global brand assets and campaign toolkits for the Mexico and LATAM markets, ensuring adherence to global brand standards while remaining culturally relevant. Performance, Innovation & Global Brand Support Monitors and reports on campaign performance, drawing out insights and recommending optimizations to franchisees and internal stakeholders. Leads the marketing calendar and contributes to the product innovation pipeline, partnering with Culinary Innovation and International Brand teams to bring locally relevant product ideas forward and support testing and launch. Develops and presents marketing and performance updates for internal leadership and franchise partners, covering brand strategy, innovation, and campaign results. Partners with Operations, Supply Chain, QA, and Training teams to ensure marketing initiatives are executed consistently across restaurants. Field Presence & Franchisee Partnership Provides daily, hands-on support to franchisees — understanding ongoing activations, surfacing challenges early, and acting as a trusted day-to-day marketing advisor. Regularly visits restaurants across Mexico and LATAM markets as required to maintain strong field/on-ground experience, evaluate in-restaurant marketing execution against approved plans, and strengthen franchisee relationships. Supports franchisees in developing and executing Local Store Marketing (LSM) plans, and monitors LSM activity against committed plans. Supports the scheduling, logistics, and content for Mexico and LATAM franchisee marketing meetings and business reviews. Tracks forecasting, billing, and reconciliation for CKE funded projects across Mexico and LATAM , ensuring accuracy and transparency across CKE and relevant franchisees. Supports the adaptation of brand marketing for the Mexico market, including culturally relevant campaign localization, regionally relevant menu promotions, and seasonal marketing moments (e.g. Dia del Niño, Día de los Muertos, Fiestas Patrias, Semana Santa, Navidad, and major football/soccer seasons), and compliance with PROFECO and CONAR advertising standards. POSITION QUALIFICATIONS/CORE COMPETENCIES 6-8 years of progressive experience in brand, product, or franchise marketing, with exposure to multi-market or international environments. Experience in F&B strongly preferred; QSR or franchise-system experience is a strong plus. Bachelor’s degree required. Experience working in or with the Mexican market, including familiarity with local consumer behavior, digital platforms (e.g. Instagram, YouTube, Rappi/Uber Eats/Didi), and culturally relevant marketing moments. Native or fluent proficiency in Spanish required; strong English proficiency also required for collaboration with global and regional teams. Exceptional communicator and project manager with the ability to influence and hold accountable franchise partners, agencies, and internal stakeholders across cultures and geographies; comfortable escalating issues through appropriate channels when needed. Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, balancing speed, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a fast-paced environment. Highly organized, strategic marketer capable of building repeatable systems, improving workflows, and driving measurable impact across markets. Commercially minded, with the ability to assess marketing/media spend effectiveness and make informed recommendations on budget allocation. Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, and discretion when working with franchise partners, agencies, and sensitive brand information. Strong on-ground field experience, with comfort spending significant time in-market and in-restaurant rather than purely office-based. WORK ENVIRONMENT Role based in a city that will ensure proximity and ease to travel to franchisee partners and key markets. Sitting for extended periods of time, using telephone, typing and/or operating a computer and/or mouse. review_candidates.title: Human Resources Information System Analyst
review_candidates.company: Danone Simpson Insurance Services, LLC DBA: Montage Insurance Solutions
review_candidates.description: Company Description Danone Simpson Insurance Services, LLC DBA: Montage Insurance Solutions is a boutique insurance brokerage specializing in employee benefits and risk management solutions for employers of varying sizes and industries. The organization focuses on delivering personalized service, strategic benefits consulting, and comprehensive insurance programs that support both organizational goals and employee well-being. Team members collaborate closely with clients to design, implement, and maintain benefits and HR-related systems that enhance efficiency and compliance. The company values professionalism, integrity, and proactive problem-solving, creating an environment where individuals can contribute to meaningful, client-focused work. Role Description The Human Resources Information System (HRIS) Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Calabasas, CA. This role is responsible for managing, configuring, and optimizing HRIS and related human capital management tools to support accurate employee data, benefits administration, and HR reporting. Day-to-day tasks include maintaining system data integrity, troubleshooting HRIS issues, creating and scheduling reports, and supporting HR and benefits teams with system workflows. The HRIS Analyst collaborates with internal stakeholders to streamline HR business processes, document requirements, and implement system enhancements or integrations. The role also supports end-users through training, guidelines, and ongoing technical assistance to ensure effective use of HR systems. Qualifications Strong Analytical Skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support decision-making. Hands-on experience with Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) and related HR technologies. Knowledge of Human Capital Management practices, including core HR and workforce data management. Understanding of Employee Benefits processes and systems used to administer and track benefits. Experience improving Business Processes, including documenting workflows and implementing system efficiencies. Proficiency in Excel and other reporting tools; ability to build and maintain recurring and ad hoc reports. Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate with HR, benefits, and operations teams. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience. Prior experience in insurance, benefits brokerage, or professional services environments is a plus.
